newsitem.title: FRANCE: Zaire's Mobutu to return home next week - aide.
newsitem.headline: Zaire's Mobutu to return home next week - aide.

text.p: Zairean President Mobutu Sese Seko, his rule under threat from rebels, will return home early next week after five months abroad, according to a close aide quoted by Radio France Internationale (RFI) on Tuesday.
RFI quoted aide Honore Ngwanda as saying Mobutu would return to Kinshasa early next week from his French Riviera mansion where he is convalescing after cancer treatment.
Aides of the 66-year-old Zairean leader have several times announced that he would return soon.
Mobutu had surgery for prostate cancer in Switzerland last August. He flew to his French Riviera mansion last month to continue his convalescence.

Zaire has been sinking deeper into trouble during his absence, with Rwanda-backed Banyamulenge rebels seizing a large swathe of territory in the east, acting as the catalyst for a wider rebel insurgency.
The rebels say their ultimate aim is to overthrow Mobutu's government.
